video_title: Melo Says We're Reading Tatum & Brown's Awkward Situation ALL WRONG

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the organizational challenges of pairing two alpha players
quotes.excerpt: It put those two guys in uncomfortable situations that both of these guys are trying to do the same thing.
quotes.quote: It is organizational structure. It is business at the end of the day. You put two guys who built something together, drafted there, All-Stars together, Finals MVP, championship, all of these things that they accomplished together. For the organization, for the business to come in and play that part and draw a wedge in that and then leave it to the two players to figure it out, it put those two guys in uncomfortable situations that both of these guys are trying to do the same thing. We won together. Now, I am an alpha, you are an alpha. We just we are not going to be alphas together no more. The business of it put a lot of friction in the middle of that to where I do not know who or what is going on. I cannot trust nobody.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: The Kid Mero and Carmelo Anthony discuss the Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown beef
quotes.excerpt: This is when Jaylen Brown left the cap emoji on Jayson Tatum's video saying that, yo, I was just as shocked as anybody.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: When they asked Jayson Tatum on a press conference, he said, yo, this ain't no show Kobe and Shaq-ish, there's no beef. This is when Jaylen Brown left the cap emoji on Jayson Tatum's video saying that, yo, I was just as shocked as anybody. I tried to call him, he didn't pick up.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: He asked me about the what what's this so-called beef.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: They asked Jaylen Brown, Jaylen Brown says, oh, you know, Jayson Tatum comes from a good family, has great PR. It's not beef, but it's maybe some lamb chops or something like that, which was a direct quote. Said there was no beef, but I mean, these not lying eyes, it definitely looked like...

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the Celtics' status as Eastern Conference contenders
quotes.excerpt: The Celtics was always going to be good. As a player, this is one of four.
quotes.quote: The Celtics was always going to be good. To me, as a player, this is one of four. So let's, okay, they got this one. Now we got to get ready for Game 2. Let's look at this as a whole. That's how they are looking at it. In four games, we got Game 1, let's go. We know what happened, we know what's going to happen in Game 2. Let's get the best out of this four.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown's professional relationship
quotes.excerpt: I don't mind the, you know, JT going over to say, you know what I mean, say what's up, give him a dap.
quotes.quote: I don't mind the, you know, JT going over to say, you know what I mean, say what's up, give him a dap and and JB doing what he's locked in. He already told y'all what's going on. It ain't like this is new. He told y'all what's going on. I'm coming to compete, I'm coming to this is on the court. He knows JT is not a bad guy. He knows there's a lot of bullshit involved in that, but that moment right there really set the tone. Let's not act like it didn't set the tone. I'm here and you got the best of me tonight and now Game 2 is coming.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on his evolving game and need for different teammates
quotes.excerpt: I can't be around a JT type of player. I need to be around a Maxey type of player.
quotes.quote: Now it comes to a point where my game is starting to expand and change and I can't be around a JT type of player. I need to be around a Maxey type of player. You get what I'm saying? It wasn't LeBron wasn't there. He wasn't in Philly when JT when Brown went there. Philly never was on the list. So he goes there and now it's a little bit more comfortable in this new situation that he's in because now he's playing with a point guard as opposed to someone who's playing my position on the court.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on Kevin Garnett's intense playing style
quotes.excerpt: Never shook a motherfucking hand. You put your hand out there, you punching your hand down.
quotes.quote: Kevin Garnett. Shout out to this guy. He's one of my one of my favorite power forwards of all time. Never shook a motherfucking hand. You put your hand out there, you punching your hand down. Fuck out of here, you bitch ass nigga. This was the energy. And where you you want to be upset about it, you got to respect it. Because you got to respect how a nigga gets into their mode in the game. That's how JB wanted to get in this mode in that game. Spin the ball. I'm going to calm it down. I'm too hyped for this shit. So let me spin the ball. Let me do some let me do something else.
